notes.title: ODD WEATHER PRESENTS RAW NERVE
notes.content:
We’re on Steam!

If we can be honest, this moment feels so surreal for the team. To think we started from a simple idea of making a simple car game to actually developing it, struggling with Unity’s WheelCollider, receiving extremely valuable feedback, going through so many iterations / versions; each more unique than the last one and finally releasing it on steam!!!! We are so proud of all of our hard work and dedication! With all that said, all of us in Odd Weather more than anything hope you enjoy this game. It is an honor for us to be here and moreover, to have people freely play this game however they like! We wish you a fun & bumpy ride with Raw Nerve!

Raw Nerve presented to you!

It’s a surreal moment for the team to say Raw Nerve runs on Steam. We started with a truck, kept the good, scrapped the bad, and built a world around our physics. It feels very special for us to be here and moreover, to have play however they like…for free. Race, or explore at your leisure. We wish you a bumpy and fun drive!

Raw Nerve is filled with paths, checkpoints, secrets, and collectables. Check out a glimpse of the first planet.


 Explore the ups and downs of a deep cave:

♥ ODD WEATHER ♥
